selection: No tuning or method selection on evaluation seeds or real acceptance counts. Primary weight fixed before first execution.
bootstrap_scope: Primary ideal acquisition, raw gas, noisy matched/short/slow/two_stage. Whole-record iid Gaussian parametric model bootstrap, residual sigma estimated on training only; interval is conditional on first-order model and iid noise, with empirical truth coverage reported.

real_data_if_pass.loho: Gas-specific median T, K, c from the nine training heats, plus common delay selected by summed normalized training free-prediction losses; held-out heat uses only its initial validation y and O, no held-out parameter fitting. Compare a separately trained no-input model.
real_data_if_pass.flow_relationship_gate: At least six accepted heats per gas; median held-out improvement >=0.1; at least eight positive LOHO held-out improvements per gas; identifiable delay intervals <=5s. Otherwise no flow-delay fit.

notes: Reuse fd47730 generator, acquisition, cleaning and ordinary fit. Short/slow use identical event centers and amplitudes with all source widths replaced by 4/30 seconds. No new dynamic structure. Confidence intervals are not physical-delay guarantees under mismatch.
